title: Could your family find the important information in an emergency?

scenes.text: Could your family find the important information they need in an emergency?
Keep key contacts, medications and allergies organized.
Add school or child-care contacts and two meeting places.
Store the sheet securely. Don't post private family information publicly.
Review it every 6 months.\nPrepared parents. Stronger families.
